nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to a single composition without scouting. Do not neglect defense, as your light defense posture makes you vulnerable to harass. Avoid unnecessary risks with your army.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue strengthening your ground army while maintaining economy and tech development. Increase production and technology further. Keep expanding to support your heavy economy.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have better scouting information about the opponent's composition or when you are ready to move to a later game phase. Also recheck if you come under pressure.
nodes.next_state_summary: Continue developing your ground army and tech, possibly transitioning to a more mixed or air-oriented composition as the game progresses.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent is Terran. Their composition and tech are not fully scouted; they may be preparing a variety of threats including bio, mech, or air. Maintain awareness of potential drops or timing attacks.
nodes.own_situation: You have a strong ground army core (Zealots, Stalkers, Observers, Immortals) and are investing heavily in technology and economy. Your production is heavy, and you have multiple expansions. Defense is light, so you may be vulnerable to harassment.
nodes.strategic_reason: Your heavy tech and economy investment gives you a long-term advantage if you can survive the midgame. A strong ground army with Observer support can defend against most Terran ground pushes and provide map control.
nodes.title: Midgame Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
nodes.transition_goal: Transition towards a more solid midgame army composition, possibly adding Colossus or transitioning to air if the opponent goes heavy on air. Ensure your economy is secure and your tech is on track.
nodes.trigger_summary: Reached midgame phase with a ground-oriented army, heavy production, heavy technology, and heavy economy. Expansion posture is heavy, defense is light or uncertain, and air presence is light or uncertain.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-extending your army without scouting. Do not delay your tech too much for army, as your economy is heavy and needs protection. Avoid taking a third base too early if you cannot defend it.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to strengthen your ground army and increase production. Maintain your economy and tech development. Consider securing a third expansion soon to support your heavy economy.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's composition or when you are about to take a third base. Also recheck if you face early pressure.
nodes.next_state_summary: Progress to a midgame state with a stronger ground army and more secure economy.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent is Terran. Their early game strategy is unknown; they could be going for a quick expand, a timing attack, or tech into cloaked units. Keep scouting to detect threats.
nodes.own_situation: You have a developing ground army (Zealots, Stalkers) and are investing heavily in tech and economy. Production is heavy, but your expansion is not yet secure. Defense is light, so you need to be careful about early pressure.
nodes.strategic_reason: Your heavy tech and economy investment will pay off in the midgame, but you need to survive the early-midgame transition. A solid ground army with Stalkers can defend against most early Terran aggression.
nodes.title: Early-Midgame Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a more solid midgame position by securing your expansion, getting Observer for detection, and preparing for potential tech choices (e.g., Colossus or air).
nodes.trigger_summary: In early-midgame phase with a ground-oriented army, heavy production, heavy technology, and heavy economy. Expansion posture is light or uncertain, defense is light or uncertain, and air presence is light or uncertain.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid being too passive; you need to apply pressure or take map control to prevent the Terran from reaching a favorable late-game. Do not neglect upgrades or tech transitions.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to strengthen your ground army and maintain your economy and tech. Consider adding more air units or transitioning to a mixed composition to counter potential Terran air threats. Keep your defense strong.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have better scouting of the Terran's late-game plan or when you are ready to move to the late game. Also recheck if you are about to engage in a major battle.
nodes.next_state_summary: Move towards a late-game army composition with a mix of ground and air units.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent is Terran. They may be transitioning to a late-game composition such as battlecruisers, ghosts, or mass marauder. Your scouting is limited, so you need to prepare for multiple possibilities.
nodes.own_situation: You have a strong ground army (Zealots, Stalkers, Void Rays, Observers) and a well-defended economy. Production and tech are heavy, and you have multiple expansions. Your defense is solid, but you need to be aware of potential late-game transitions by the opponent.
nodes.strategic_reason: Your heavy tech and economy allow you to transition to a powerful late-game army. A ground army with Void Ray support can handle most Terran compositions, but you need to be flexible.
nodes.title: Late-Midgame Ground Macro with Heavy Tech
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to a late-game composition that can counter the Terran's final army. This may involve adding more air units, getting Colossus, or investing in upgrades.
nodes.trigger_summary: In late-midgame phase with a ground-oriented army, heavy production, heavy technology, heavy economy, and heavy defense. Expansion is heavy, and air presence is light or uncertain.

nodes.avoid_direction: Avoid over-committing to tech without any army; you need some defense. Do not take a fast third base if you cannot defend it. Avoid being greedy without scouting.
nodes.decision_direction: Continue to develop your economy and technology. Increase production as you expand. Keep a small defensive force to protect against early pressure.
nodes.exit_or_recheck_condition: Recheck when you have scouted the opponent's strategy or when you are about to take a second or third base. Also recheck if you face early pressure.
nodes.next_state_summary: Progress to an early-midgame state with a stronger army and more production.
nodes.opponent_situation: Opponent is Terran. Their early game strategy is unknown; they could be going for a fast expand, a marine rush, or a tech build. Keep scouting to detect any early aggression.
nodes.own_situation: You are in the early game, focusing on technology and economy. You have a Zealot or two for defense, but your army is not yet defined. Production is moderate, and you are investing heavily in tech.
nodes.strategic_reason: Your heavy tech and economy investment will give you a strong midgame, but you need to survive the early game. A few Zealots can hold off early rushes while you tech up.
nodes.title: Early Game Tech/Economy Opening
nodes.transition_goal: Transition to an early-midgame state with a solid ground army and a secure economy. Start producing Stalkers and get an Observer for detection.
nodes.trigger_summary: In early game phase with unknown army domain, moderate production, heavy technology, and heavy economy. Expansion is light or uncertain, defense is light or uncertain, and air presence is light or uncertain.

opening.flexibility_note: This is a strategic template, not a fixed build order.
opening.opening_summary: A Protoss opening that emphasizes heavy technology and economy investment while maintaining moderate production. The army is initially ground-oriented, with potential to branch into air or mixed compositions later. The opening is flexible and designed to support a macro-oriented midgame.
opening.strategic_goal: Develop a technology / economy / production posture while preserving flexibility for live observation-driven adaptation.
